card.name: Words before countries or organizations
card.fires_on: Small linking or counting words (as, in, different, only, the, smallest) that come right before a country, region, or group of states or organizations in geopolitical news text.

modes.label: Linking word before places
modes.description: Prepositions such as as, in, or into that lead to a region or place name.
modes.example: create an integrated oceans policy in places such<< as>> the Arctic, the Baltic, and the

modes.label: Count or rank word before countries
modes.description: Words like different, only, or smallest that precede a noun for countries or companies.
modes.example: have been commissioned by 15<< different>> countries.

card.writes: It pushes against plural group nouns after a number, such as 'three companies' or 'several agencies', and slightly favors singular-person words in Chinese and Japanese.
card.plain: It fires on small words in world-affairs writing that come just before a country or group is named.
